slides.text:
310K+ GitHub stars.
50+ integrations.
Runs <accent>locally</accent> on your machine.

OpenClaw is the open-source AI agent
that actually <accent>does things</accent> for you.

This is Part 1 of a 4-part series.

slides.heading: What is <accent>OpenClaw?</accent>
slides.body:
- Open-source AI agent (Node.js)
- Connects to Claude, GPT, DeepSeek
- Works via WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord
- Runs locally - your data stays with you
- Plans and executes multi-step tasks autonomously

slides.heading: Before vs <accent>After</accent> OpenClaw
after: AI triages and drafts email replies
One agent coordinates all your tools

slides.heading: Why Developers <accent>Love</accent> It
items: Open source - full control, no vendor lock-in
50+ messaging integrations out of the box
Agentic - it plans, decides, and executes
Fastest growing OSS repo in history

slides.heading: It Actually <accent>Does</accent> Things
slides.body:
Tell it to scaffold a React app.
It runs the commands.
Tell it to debug your code.
It reads, fixes, and commits.

terminal.text: You: scaffold a React app with Tailwind

slides.text:
OpenClaw doesn't just answer questions.
It takes action.
That's the difference between
a chatbot and an AI agent.

slides.heading: Who Is This <accent>For?</accent>
slides.body:
- Developers automating repetitive workflows
- Solo founders wearing 10 hats
- Freelancers managing clients and projects
- Anyone who wants a personal AI operator
